plainName: Two cross-ice games, one in each end
gear: Barrier pads along both blue lines, 4 small nets, pucks
description: Barrier pads go across both blue lines, so each end becomes its own small rink. Play a cross-ice game in each end: two small nets against the side boards, one team on each. The neutral zone stays empty. Change lines often so everyone plays.
steps: Win the puck and skate it toward the other team's net.
Shoot when you're close. Then go get it back!
cues: Lose it? Go get it back!

focus.why: Lots of puck touches, shots and goals in a small space.
Real game reads: where the puck is, where the net is, who's open.

source.label: Our Sunday practice
source.note: How our team runs Sunday ice: most of the time is two half-ice games across the ice, with barrier pads along the blue lines.
